notes.ssenga: Shwenkazi, the father’s sister, the bride’s adviser.
notes.kwanjula: Okwanjura, the bride introduces the groom to her family.
notes.mwebale-okujja: To a group: thank you for coming.

guidebook.intro: Weddings, introductions and birthdays: the words to congratulate, invite and wish people well.

tips.title: Okwanjura: the introduction
body: Before a wedding, the bride introduces her groom to her family at the **okwanjura**. The groom’s family brings gifts, **ebiconco**, and the father’s sister, **shwenkazi**, plays a key role.
Bridewealth in Ankole was traditionally paid in cows.

tips.title: Wishing well
body: **Twakushemererwa!** is congratulations, literally “we’re happy for you”. Thank guests for coming with **Mwebale kwija**. For a holiday: **Ebiro bikuru birungi!** (happy holidays) and **Omwaka omuhyaka murungi!** (happy new year).

culture.title: Ekitaguriro at weddings
body: Ankole weddings end in dancing: the **ekitaguriro**, where dancers stamp and raise their arms like the horns of a cow, to the sound of drums and songs.
